QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Into Verne Mine
QuestInfo.0: What kind of guard lets a person through just because they have a hat? Anyways, time to look for the materials you need.
QuestInfo.1: Venture deeper and find the researchers. They should know where you can get research materials.
QuestInfo.2: As you were escaping the mine you heard the voice of a child in need. You thought of #p9201714# and #p9201720# and realized you couldn't turn a blind eye. You saved the child and even procured the suspicious crystals you needed.
